label: Excel MCP
tagline: A read-only MCP server that lets an agent read the .xlsx, .xlsm and .csv files in one folder.

label: PDF MCP
tagline: A read-only MCP server that lets an agent read and search the PDF documents in one folder, with optional OCR for scanned pages.

label: SQL Server MCP
tagline: A read-only MCP server that lets an agent find, describe and query the tables of one SQL Server database.

label: PostgreSQL MCP
tagline: A read-only MCP server that lets an agent find, describe and query the tables of one PostgreSQL database, every query inside a read-only transaction.

label: XML MCP
tagline: A read-only MCP server that lets an agent read, search, query and tabulate the XML documents in one folder.

label: HTTP Catalog
tagline: The ASP.NET Core and NestJS SDKs that turn an existing backend's endpoints into a searchable agent tool catalog.

label: Local LLM MCP
tagline: An MCP server that lets a planning agent hand bounded language work, such as summarising files or labelling rows, to a model on your own Ollama.
